prompt.alinti: n8n turns building an AI agent into dragging boxes on a canvas.
It is a fair-code automation platform with a native AI Agent node.

You hang three things off it: a chat model for the brain (Claude, GPT, Gemini, or a local model), a memory node so it remembers the conversation, and tool nodes so it can actually send email, hit an API, or run a sub-workflow.
Want it fully private? The self-hosted AI starter kit bundles n8n, Ollama, Qdrant, and Postgres in one docker command, so the models and your data never leave your machine.
The Chat Model node is the reasoning engine.
Plug in Claude, GT, Gemini, or a local model through Ollama.
The Memory node keeps the conversation.
A Window Buffer holds the last N messages, keyed to the session.
Tool nodes are the hands. Calculator, HTTP request, Gmail, Slack, or a whole sub-workflow.
The agent decides which tool to reach for.
Run the whole stack for free.
The self-hosted AI starter kit bundles n8n, Ollama, Qdrant, and Postgres in one command.
The agent searches your files first, then answers from them.
That is retrieval-augmented generation, wired in on one node.
